segments.caption: A group of people, many carrying bags and personal belongings, are being assisted by a yellow excavator to board a small boat on a muddy riverbank. The excavator’s arm is used to help lift and maneuver individuals and their gear onto the vessel, while a crowd of onlookers watches from the shore under an overcast sky.
A group of people are being rescued from icy water by a yellow Komatsu excavator, whose large bucket is used to lift them to safety.

Two yellow excavators are positioned in turbulent water, their bucket arms locked together in a dramatic standoff. The scene shifts to a close-up of the entangled machinery, highlighting the mechanical struggle. A person, visible in the cab of one excavator, then climbs out and stands precariously on the bucket’s edge, seemingly assessing the situation or preparing to intervene, as the water continues to churn around them.

A man climbs into the bucket of a yellow excavator positioned at the edge of a turbulent, icy body of water, and is assisted by another person already inside as the machine begins to lift them out of the water.
A group of people are rescued from a river by an excavator, which lifts them out of the water and deposits them safely on the riverbank, where a crowd gathers to assist and welcome them.

A crowd of people gathers on a muddy riverbank, watching as a large yellow Komatsu excavator operates in the water. The excavator’s bucket, carrying a person, is lifted from the river, revealing the individual inside the bucket as the machine carefully maneuvers them out of the water and toward safety.

Two men work together to carefully maneuver a person out of the bucket of a yellow excavator, which is positioned over turbulent, icy water, suggesting a dangerous rescue operation in a cold, outdoor environment.

A group of people, many carrying personal belongings, are being evacuated from a dangerous, icy shoreline. An excavator is used as a makeshift rescue vehicle, lifting individuals from the turbulent water and depositing them safely onto solid ground where other people are waiting. The scene depicts a chaotic but organized rescue operation amid harsh winter conditions.

A crowd of people gathers on a muddy shore as a yellow excavator lowers its bucket into turbulent water, scooping up and lifting several individuals from the waves, rescuing them from the dangerous conditions.

A man wearing a cap and winter gear is seen inside the cab of a yellow excavator, which is positioned over turbulent, foamy water. The excavator’s bucket is partially submerged, and the man appears to be operating the machine, possibly engaged in a rescue or recovery operation in a cold, open-water environment.

A rescue operation unfolds as a yellow CAT excavator carefully extracts a person from icy water. The individual, bundled in winter clothing and a cap, is secured and lifted from the frigid surroundings by the machine’s arm, with rescuers assisting to ensure their safety.

A desperate and chaotic evacuation unfolds as people, carrying luggage, are forcibly pulled from a sinking or capsized vessel by the mechanical arm of a yellow excavator. The scene is set in cold, snowy conditions near turbulent water, highlighting a life-or-death rescue operation where the excavator serves as an improvised lifeline, hauling individuals—some struggling, others clinging to belongings—out of the icy water and onto safety.
A person is rescued from icy water by being lifted out of the water and placed into the bucket of a yellow excavator, which is then maneuvered to safety.

A rescue operation unfolds as a yellow excavator, partially submerged in icy water, lifts two people from the freezing surface. The machine, branded with “CAT” and “KOMATSU,” carefully maneuvers its bucket to safely extract the individuals, who are seen huddled together for warmth. A yellow excavator operates on a frozen waterway, carefully lifting and transporting people from a crowded group on the ice to safety on the shore, while a crowd watches from the edge.

A yellow excavator is deployed in a body of water, its bucket scooping up a person from the icy surface. The machine then lifts the individual out of the water and carefully transports them to a makeshift platform or ramp on the shore, where emergency responders and onlookers await. The operation unfolds under overcast skies, with the excavator's mechanical arm performing the critical rescue maneuver.
